===Burning a shade===
{{Checklist|
*Use the sacred oil on a log to create a [[Pyre logs|pyre log]].
*Head west of Mort'ton general store, to any grouping of 4 stone funeral pyres. Use the pyre log, then Loar remains on a [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)#Cremating the Shades|funeral pyre]]. 
*Light the funeral pyre. '''Note:''' This will grant 25 Prayer XP.
*Collect the reward.
*(Recommended) Use the Serum 208 on Razmire.
*Use the Serum 208 on Ulsquire and finish the dialogue.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
